name: Revenue by country
prompt: Revenue by country: a ranked table of countries, headline KPIs, and the top countries and segment split.

binding.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT country) AS countries FROM customer_segments
SELECT ROUND(SUM(revenue),0) AS revenue FROM customer_segments
SELECT ROUND(MAX(c.rev),0) AS top FROM (SELECT country, SUM(revenue) AS rev FROM customer_segments GROUP BY country) c

SELECT country AS country, SUM(customers) AS customers, SUM(orders) AS orders, ROUND(SUM(revenue),0) AS revenue, ROUND(SUM(revenue)/NULLIF(SUM(orders),0),0) AS avg_order_value FROM customer_segments GROUP BY country ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 50

copy.title: Revenue by country
copy.caption: The UK, Australia and India lead, each within $20K of one another.

binding.sql: SELECT country AS country, ROUND(SUM(revenue),0) AS revenue FROM customer_segments GROUP BY country ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 10

copy.title: Top countries
copy.caption: Revenue is well-balanced across markets — no single country dominates.

binding.sql: SELECT segment AS segment, ROUND(SUM(revenue),0) AS revenue FROM customer_segments GROUP BY segment ORDER BY revenue DESC

copy.title: Revenue by segment
copy.caption: Pro accounts contribute the largest slice of worldwide revenue.
